verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers an Agent SDK for building custom agents with 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions,' and the CLI is designed to be composable/scriptable (piping, CI use), suggesting strong programmatic access. However, there's no explicit evidence that every UI-specific feature (e.g., Remote Control, teleport, IDE diff viewers, GitHub Code Review UI) has a documented equivalent API/SDK parity.
